name: FileBrowser Quantum
tagline: Access your homeserver files from your browser
description:
FileBrowser Quantum

An easy way to access and manage your files from the web . It has a modern responsive interface that has many advanced features to manage users, access, sharing, and file preview and editing. ## First start Default credentials are `admin:admin`. You **should absolutely** change this password, you can also add new users from the settings. ### Documentation See the [Official Docs](https://filebrowserquantum.com/)
compose:
x-runtipi:
  schema_version: 2
services:
  filebrowser-quantum:
    image: gtstef/filebrowser:2.0-stable
    volumes:
      - ${ROOT_FOLDER_HOST}/media:/runtipi/media
      - ${ROOT_FOLDER_HOST}/app-data:/runtipi/app-data
      - ${ROOT_FOLDER_HOST}/user-config:/runtipi/user-config
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/home/filebrowser/data
    x-runtipi:
      internal_port: 80
      is_main: true
